title: GMV
question: 上个月华东区的 GMV
sql:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(o.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM orders AS o
JOIN regions AS r
  ON o.region_id = r.region_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
  AND r.region_name = '华东'
LIMIT 1000

    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
